aliases: Aspects to consider when designing competency assessment

one_line_answer.text: An assessment should reflect, as near as possible, the real conditions which normally exist.

cites.quote: An assessment should always reflect, as near as possible, the real conditions which normally exist.

keywords.bn: বাইরের বিষয়, যেমন আইন ও নীতি

bangla_explanation: Assessment সাধারণত training institute বা workplace-এ হয়।
যেখানেই হোক, assessment যতটা সম্ভব real conditions-এর মতো হতে হবে।
Assessment তৈরির সময় আটটি দিক ভাবতে হয়: purposes থেকে outcomes পর্যন্ত।
Workplace-এ noise, onlookers, production আর shift-এর মতো বাধা থাকে, তাই আগে থেকে ভাবা জরুরি।

example.en: A garments factory assesses a sewing operator. The assessor plans around noise and shift times.
example.bn: কারখানায় assessment হলে noise আর shift আগে থেকে বিবেচনা করতে হয়।

list_answer.title: Considerations for workplace assessment
list_answer.title_bn: Workplace assessment-এ যেসব দিক বিবেচনা করতে হয়

items.text: Purposes: diagnosing training needs, recognising existing competencies, recruitment or promotion.

cites.quote: Purposes - as mentioned earlier, it could be for diagnosing education and training needs, recognising existing competencies, or recruitment or promotion etc.

items.text: Environment: noise, onlookers, weather conditions, night/day, organisational culture.

cites.quote: Environment - noise, onlookers, weather conditions, night/day, organisational culture.

items.text: Internal factors: industrial relations, availability of standards and resources, production and shifts.

cites.quote: Internal factors - industrial relations issues, availability of standards
availability of resources, production and shift considerations

items.text: External factors: relevant policies and legislation, access and equity, occupational safety and health.

cites.quote: External factors - relevant policies and legislation, access and equity, occupational safety and health.

items.text: Methods: observation, written tests, practical tests, interviews, projects, samples of work.

cites.quote: Methods - could include observation, written tests, practical tests, interviews, project or assignments, samples of work etc.

items.text: Feelings: anxiety, stress, self consciousness, fear, friendship, peer pressure.

cites.quote: Feelings - anxiety, stress, self consciousness, fear, friendship, peer pressure

items.text: Outcomes: security and recording of results, appeals, retraining and reassessment.

cites.quote: Outcomes - security and recording of results, appeals, opportunities for retraining and reassessment policies.

items_bn: Assessment কেন — training needs খোঁজা, আগের দক্ষতার স্বীকৃতি, নাকি recruitment বা promotion; সেটা আগে ঠিক করো।
শব্দ, দর্শক, আবহাওয়া, দিন-রাত, প্রতিষ্ঠানের culture — চারপাশের এসব assessment-কে প্রভাবিত করে।
প্রতিষ্ঠানের ভেতরের বিষয়: industrial relations, standards ও resources পাওয়া, production আর shifts।
বাইরের বিষয়: সংশ্লিষ্ট policies ও legislation, access and equity, occupational safety and health।
কোন methods ব্যবহার হবে: observation, written tests, practical tests, interviews, projects বা কাজের নমুনা।
Candidate-এর অনুভূতি — anxiety, stress, ভয়, বন্ধুত্ব বা peer pressure — তার কাজকে প্রভাবিত করে, তাই মাথায় রাখতে হয়।
আগে আলোচিত assessment principles মানা হচ্ছে কি না, তাও দেখতে হয়।
ফলাফলের নিরাপত্তা ও recording, appeals, আবার training ও reassessment-এর সুযোগ — এগুলো আগেই ঠিক রাখতে হয়।

short.prompt: What aspects should be considered when designing a workplace competency assessment?
short.modelAnswer:
An assessment should reflect the real conditions as near as possible. Consider:
1. Purposes
2. Environment
3. Internal factors
4. External factors
5. Methods
6. Feelings
7. Assessment principles
8. Outcomes

keyPoints.text: Environment: noise, onlookers, weather conditions, night/day, organisational culture.

cites.quote: Environment - noise, onlookers, weather conditions, night/day, organisational culture.

keyPoints.text: Methods should be appropriate and relevant to the normal activities in your workplace.

cites.quote: The methods chosen should be appropriate and relevant to the normal activities which happen in your workplace.

keyPoints.text: Outcomes: security and recording of results, appeals, retraining and reassessment policies.

cites.quote: Outcomes - security and recording of results, appeals, opportunities for retraining and reassessment policies.
